column1: # The Learn & Play counterparts of the Mac online layer's names (tools/targets/names/overrides/online.list,
# tools/targets/mac-x64/symbols.map), found by MSVC RTTI (type descriptor -> complete object locator -> vtable),
# the strings each function uses, and the call-graph and vtable shape against the decrypted Mac image.
# ADDRESS: runtime address (image base 0xf80000, what F_<addr> and the vtables hold); LINK = ADDRESS - 0xb80000.
# Windows vtables have one scalar deleting destructor (slot 8) where the Mac's Itanium ones have two (8, 9):
# Mac slot m >= 10 is Windows slot m - 1. USE: what online32.c does with it.

column7: EVIDENCE

stores the vtables of RSConnectGameInterface_Impl (0x143c9dd), RSConnectService_Steam (0x143ca64), RSDLCService_Steam (0x143cad5), RSProfileService_Win32 (0x143cb54); calls the RSConnectExtension_RDV constructor (0x143cbbe), its only caller

RTTI .?AVRSConnectExtension_RDV@@: type descriptor 0x1e77e4c, locator 0x1dab6f8; 37 slots; slots 9-36 are 16-byte thunks to the manager at +8, in Mac order (Windows 15 empty, 16 returns true, 27/28/36 return through a hidden pointer, 26 builds job type 0xb inline like Mac slot 27, 0x100a21210)
writes RSConnectExtension vtable 0x1d5e7ec then RDV 0x1d5d934, refs (+4) 0, manager 0x48 bytes at +8 (ctor 0x144ddb0: zero fill only); this on the stack, ret 4; sizeof 0xc
vtable slot 8, scalar deleting destructor (flags & 1 frees 0xc bytes through the efd allocator 0x149e770)
returned by slot 6 (0x144b290), searched by QueryInterface (slot 4/5, 0x144b2a0): {count; {id, name, ?, offset}...}, filled at startup (.bss)
called by RDV slot 11; posts ("LoginFail", "Cred") at 0x144e91c, ("LoginFail", "Key") 0x144e9bd, ("LoginFail", "Err") 0x144ea4a through game interface slot 57 (0xe4)
read by 0x1438130 (RSConnectService getter); slot 129 (0x204) returns the extension
read by 0x1438150 (RSConnectGameInterface getter), the next word after rs_connect_service as on the Mac
no MSVC RTTI; stored by rsconnect_factory (0x143c9dd); slot 57 0x1123f50 is the event method (name &, param &, extra by value; ret 0xc), slot 67 GetConfigBool

game interface slot 67, called with "RendezVous.SkipLogin" (0x1d5cfd8) by the sign-in state machine at 0x143f4c4 ([edx+0x10c]); same shape as the Mac: ConfigManager 0x7000005 from the service manager ([0x1ee0bfc]+4, slot 15), QueryInterface (slot 5), GetBool (slot 20 = Mac 21), the default when any step fails; key is an efd string (0x18 bytes), ret 8; only called through the vtable

RSProfileService slot 12 (= Mac 13) in the base (0x1d5d1ec) and RSProfileService_Win32 (0x1d5d8c4) vtables; the same checks as the Mac function: prev +0x28, state +0x2c, blocks +0x71/+0x73/+0x74, player <= 1, pad <= 3, pad of player +4, player of pad +0xc, set-pad slot 16, player +0x5c, state 1, active +0x24; ret 8; only called through the vtable
RTTI .?AVRSProfileService_Win32@@: type descriptor 0x1e77e00, locator 0x1dab6a4; 33 slots

RSProfileService_Win32 slot 10 (= Mac 11): skips when player (+0x5c) != 0; sub-state (+0xcc) 0 with state 1 reads cloud file "crd" (0x1d5d870), then logs in (AutoLogin, extension slot 12) or posts "RS2UplayLogin" (0x1d44290); 2 and 3 other steps; any other sub-state does nothing
RSProfileService_Win32 slot 25 (= Mac 26): sets sub-state (+0xcc) 4, the value the sign-in wrapper writes

no function: the config getter 0x1161260 returns the static settings block 0x1f0bbf0 and the one reader of AutoLogin (+0x65, ini key "AutoLogin=" 0x1d60210 in the serializer 0x149d610) is 0x144a7aa, inside the profile tick's sub-state 0 branch, which the sign-in wrapper keeps the tick out of
refers to "en-GB" (0x1d552b0, the Mac function's first language) and "http://uplay.com" (0x1d5cecc); calls ShellExecuteA (wrapper site 0x143c87f), which the Win32 seam refuses (win32_misc.c)
esi = the manager, called from 0x144394a before the coordinator waits for its active downloads; F_144bbd0 in win32_overrides.c does nothing, as the Mac override
RSRDVDownloadManager queue of a named request: thiscall (name, job), the job a Callback<PreviewFile> (RTTI vtable 0x1d5d350), called from 0x1443f91 and 0x1445219; F_144bc80 in win32_overrides.c
the same with a type (Callback<RSDLCCoordinator>, RTTI vtable 0x1d5d364), called from 0x14440d4; F_144bdb0 in win32_overrides.c
reads the extension's manager (+0x10 on the Mac) directly; the Mac stub keeps its own state there, the Windows build keeps the game's sessionless manager at +8
